input.query:
WITH RECURSIVE path(ind, start_id, transfer_id, links, trail) AS (
SELECT indicator_id, transfer_id, transfer_id, 0, transfer_id FROM alert_contributions
UNION ALL
SELECT path.ind, path.start_id, o.debit_transfer_id, path.links+1, path.trail||'>'||o.debit_transfer_id FROM path JOIN onward_links o ON o.credit_transfer_id = path.transfer_id)
SELECT ind, trail, links, t.receiver, t.sender, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM onward_links WHERE credit_transfer_id = path.transfer_id) AS ends FROM path JOIN transfers t ON t.transfer_id=path.transfer_id WHERE links>0 ORDER BY ind, trail

findings.statement: Scope: one bounded replay (run:5ce89f521e5e, 50000 dataset events, 3 of 3 jobs completed, clink exit status 0, not cancelled; fan-in threshold 5 distinct senders per 1-hour event-time window; onward gap of up to 30 minutes). The dataset holds 50000 transfers, 12072 accounts, 12321 devices, 691 onward links and 6 fan-in alerts. Everything below holds only for this dataset as this run processed it.

Alert fan_in:A-10859:1794924000000: account A-10859, window 1794924000000 to 1794927600000, 6 senders, 6 transfers, total 204000 (T011431, T011465, T011494, T011536, T011572, T011610). Every contributing transfer has an onward link. The candidate onward-transfer paths are up to 3 onward links long and split in two. One path goes A-10859 > A-78340 > A-75793 > A-92332 (T011583, T011600, T011628). The other goes A-10859 > A-78340 > A-85287 (T011670 or T011583, then T011695). The paths end at A-92332 and A-85287, where this dataset has no further qualifying transfer. Path accounts: A-10859, A-78340, A-75793, A-92332, A-85287. Shared device: D-79802 sent transfers from both A-10859 and A-78340, the alerted account and the next account on the paths. It sent T011583, T011670, T011600 and T011695.

Alert fan_in:A-37573:1794823200000: account A-37573, window 1794823200000 to 1794826800000, 7 senders, 7 transfers, total 379500 (T003057, T003091, T003124, T003154, T003248, T003287, T003319). All 7 have onward links. There are two parallel candidate paths, each 4 onward links long, over the same accounts A-37573 > A-38045 > A-93288 > A-63022 > A-54215. The first runs T003168, T003182, T003201, T003222. The second runs T003391, T003416, T003433, T003454. Both end at A-54215, where this dataset has no further qualifying transfer. Shared device: D-45880 sent all 8 onward transfers, covering 4 of the 5 path accounts (A-37573, A-38045, A-93288, A-63022). A-54215 sent no transfers in this dataset.

Alert fan_in:A-83577:1795057200000: account A-83577, window 1795057200000 to 1795060800000, 8 senders, 8 transfers, total 174500 (T022417 to T022561). All 8 have onward links. One candidate path follows, 5 onward links long: A-83577 > A-56768 > A-83094 > A-43725 > A-14799 > A-39382 (T022572, T022592, T022609, T022629, T022649). It ends at A-39382, where this dataset has no further qualifying transfer. Shared device: D-40018 sent from both A-83094 (T022609) and A-14799 (T022649). These two accounts are not next to each other on the path. D-40018 also sent T038409 from A-34114, an account that is not on this alert's paths. The other onward transfers on the path came from distinct devices.

Alert fan_in:A-20636:1795190400000: account A-20636, window 1795190400000 to 1795194000000, 6 senders, 6 transfers, total 36000. Five contributing transfers each have an onward link to the same debit, T033506 (A-20636 to A-36729, 30000). T033316 has no onward link. The longest path is 1 onward link, ending at A-36729. Path accounts: A-20636, A-36729. No device was shared between them. A-36729's only outgoing transfer, T034128, came 7800000 ms (about 2.2 h) after T033506, beyond the 30-minute gap.

Alert fan_in:A-85921:1794855600000: account A-85921, window 1794855600000 to 1794859200000, 6 senders, 6 transfers, each 2500, total 15000. Four contributing transfers each have an onward link to T005888 (A-85921 to A-10758, 9500). T005934 and T005978 have no onward link. The longest path is 1 onward link, ending at A-10758. Path accounts: A-85921, A-10758. No device was shared between them.

Alert fan_in:A-28137:1795003200000: account A-28137, window 1795003200000 to 1795006800000, 7 senders, 7 transfers, total 29500. None of the 7 contributing transfers has an onward link, so the alert starts no candidate path (max depth 0, no end accounts, and A-28137 is the only path account). A-28137's only outgoing transfer in the dataset, T018852 at 1795013700000, is more than 30 minutes after its last contributing credit (T018248 at 1795006260000).
None of the accounts where paths end (A-92332, A-85287, A-54215, A-39382, A-36729, A-10758) has a fan-in indicator of its own.

What separates the six alerts, which look similar as indicators (6 to 8 senders, one hour each): (a) onward-link depth runs 0 (A-28137), 1 (A-20636, A-85921), 3 (A-10859), 4 (A-37573) and 5 (A-83577). (b) The shape differs: one branch in A-10859 ends at two accounts, two parallel paths over the same accounts in A-37573 end at one account, and A-83577 has a single linear path. (c) Devices: the deeper three each have a device that sent from two or more of their path accounts (D-79802, D-45880, D-40018). The shallow or empty three have none. D-45880 is the strongest case, with one device behind every onward transfer from 4 path accounts. (d) A-28137 has no onward links at all, so for it there is no recorded relationship beyond the fan-in itself. All of this traces back to recorded transfers, links and device fields (traceable provenance), but none of it establishes fraud, common control or the movement of the same funds.

hypotheses.statement: In alert A-37573, one device (D-45880) sends a quick series of onward transfers through four accounts, each a few minutes after the credit before it and slightly smaller. This could fit the four accounts being operated together, as in a layering pattern. The data records only the device field and the timing. It does not establish who controlled the accounts or that the same funds moved.

In alerts A-10859 and A-83577, a device is shared by path accounts (D-79802 and D-40018). This could point to a common operator on parts of those paths. D-40018 is also used by an off-path account (A-34114), which may instead suggest a shared or public device.

Alert A-28137 has no onward links and no shared device on its route. It may be benign collection activity, such as small payments from many senders. A-20636 and A-85921, each with a single onward hop, may be similar. The data does not establish this either way.

unresolved.question: Who owns or controls the path accounts and the shared devices D-45880, D-79802 and D-40018? The data records device use only, not identity.
What happens at the end accounts (A-92332, A-85287, A-54215, A-39382, A-36729, A-10758) outside this bounded dataset? A path ending here only means this dataset has no further qualifying transfer.
Do the onward transfers carry the same funds as the contributing credits? Onward links record timing only.
Would activity outside the replay change the picture for A-28137, or for transfers whose debits may fall more than 30 minutes after the credit, such as T018852 and T034128?
